terraform {
  required_providers {
    aws = {
      source  = "hashicorp/aws"
      version = ">= 4.0"
    }
  }
}

provider "aws" {
  region = "us-east-1"
}

resource "aws_iam_user" "tj" {
  name = "TJ"
}

data "aws_iam_policy_document" "glacier_efs_ec2" {
  statement {
    sid    = "EC2Management"
    effect = "Allow"
    actions = [
      "ec2:AttachVolume",
      "ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupEgress",
      "ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress",
      "ec2:CreateKeyPair",
      "ec2:CreateSecurityGroup",
      "ec2:CreateSnapshot",
      "ec2:CreateTags",
      "ec2:CreateVolume",
      "ec2:DeleteKeyPair",
      "ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup",
      "ec2:DeleteSnapshot",
      "ec2:DeleteTags",
      "ec2:DeleteVolume",
      "ec2:Describe*",
      "ec2:DetachVolume",
      "ec2:GetConsoleOutput",
      "ec2:ImportKeyPair",
      "ec2:ModifyInstanceAttribute",
      "ec2:ModifyVolume",
      "ec2:RebootInstances",
      "ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupEgress",
      "ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress",
      "ec2:RunInstances",
      "ec2:StartInstances",
      "ec2:StopInstances",
      "ec2:TerminateInstances"
    ]
    resources = ["*"]
  }

  statement {
    sid    = "EFSClientAccess"
    effect = "Allow"
    actions = [
      "elasticfilesystem:ClientMount",
      "elasticfilesystem:ClientWrite",
      "elasticfilesystem:ClientRootAccess",
      "elasticfilesystem:DescribeFileSystems",
      "elasticfilesystem:DescribeMountTargets"
    ]
    resources = ["*"]
  }

  statement {
    sid    = "GlacierVaultAndMultipart"
    effect = "Allow"
    actions = [
      "glacier:AbortMultipartUpload",
      "glacier:CompleteMultipartUpload",
      "glacier:CreateVault",
      "glacier:DeleteArchive",
      "glacier:DeleteVault",
      "glacier:DescribeJob",
      "glacier:DescribeVault",

final_template:
terraform {
  required_version = ">= 1.0"

  required_providers {
    aws = {
      source  = "hashicorp/aws"
      version = ">= 4.0"
    }
  }
}

provider "aws" {}

variable "rolename" {
  description = "Name of the IAM role granted to the third-party security auditing platform"
  type        = string
  default     = "WizAccess-Role"
}

variable "remote-arn" {
  description = "ARN of the remote AWS principal allowed to assume the role"
  type        = string
  default     = "arn:aws:iam::830522659852:role/prod-us43-AssumeRoleDelegator"
}

variable "external-id" {
  description = "External ID required when assuming the role"
  type        = string
  default     = "fc959d31-537c-4108-8b87-9af9e0c9b8d2"
}

data "aws_iam_policy_document" "assume_role" {
  statement {
    effect  = "Allow"
    actions = ["sts:AssumeRole"]

    principals {
      type        = "AWS"
      identifiers = [var.remote-arn]
    }

    condition {
      test     = "StringEquals"
      variable = "sts:ExternalId"
      values   = [var.external-id]
    }
  }
}

resource "aws_iam_role" "wiz_access" {
  name               = var.rolename
  description        = "Cross-account role for third-party security auditing platform"
  assume_role_policy = data.aws_iam_policy_document.assume_role.json
}

resource "aws_iam_role_policy_attachment" "view_only_access" {
  role       = aws_iam_role.wiz_access.name
  policy_arn = "arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/job-function/ViewOnlyAccess"
}

resource "aws_iam_role_policy_attachment" "security_audit" {
  role       = aws_iam_role.wiz_access.name
  policy_arn = "arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/SecurityAudit"
}

data "aws_iam_policy_document" "wiz_custom" {
  statement {
    effect = "Allow"
    actions = [
      "acm:GetCertificate",
      "apigateway:GET",
      "backup:DescribeGlobalSettings",

      "backup:ListTags",
      "cloudtrail:GetInsightSelectors",
      "cloudtrail:ListTrails",
      "codebuild:BatchGetProjects",
      "codebuild:GetResourcePolicy",
      "codebuild:ListProjects",
      "cognito-identity:DescribeIdentityPool",
      "connect:ListInstances",
      "connect:ListInstanceAttributes",
      "connect:ListInstanceStorageConfigs",
      "connect:ListSecurityKeys",
      "connect:ListLexBots",
      "connect:ListLambdaFunctions",
      "connect:ListApprovedOrigins",
      "connect:ListIntegrationAssociations",
      "dynamodb:DescribeExport",
      "dynamodb:DescribeKinesisStreamingDestination",
      "dynamodb:ListExports",
      "ec2:GetEbsEncryptionByDefault",
      "ec2:SearchTransitGatewayRoutes",
      "ecr:BatchGetImage",
      "ecr:GetAuthorizationToken",
      "ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer",
      "ecr:GetRegistryPolicy",
      "ecr:DescribeRegistry",
      "eks:ListTagsForResource",
      "elasticfilesystem:DescribeAccessPoints",
      "elasticfilesystem:DescribeFileSystemPolicy",
      "elasticmapreduce:GetAutoTerminationPolicy",
      "elasticmapreduce:GetManagedScalingPolicy",
      "ssm:GetDocument",
      "ssm:GetParameters",
      "ssm:GetParameter",

      "glacier:GetDataRetrievalPolicy",
      "glacier:GetVaultLock",
      "glue:GetConnection",

      "glue:GetTags",
      "health:DescribeAffectedAccountsForOrganization",
      "health:DescribeAffectedEntities",
      "health:DescribeAffectedEntitiesForOrganization",
      "health:DescribeEntityAggregates",
      "health:DescribeEventAggregates",
      "health:DescribeEventDetails",
      "health:DescribeEventDetailsForOrganization",
      "health:DescribeEventTypes",
      "health:DescribeEvents",
      "health:DescribeEventsForOrganization",
      "health:DescribeHealthServiceStatusForOrganization",
      "kafka:ListClusters",
      "kendra:DescribeDataSource",
      "kendra:DescribeIndex",
      "kendra:ListDataSources",
      "kendra:ListIndices",
      "kendra:ListTagsForResource",
      "kinesisanalytics:ListApplications",

      "profile:ListIntegrations",

      "s3:GetMultiRegionAccessPointPolicy",

      "ses:DescribeActiveReceiptRuleSet",

      "ses:GetConfigurationSetEventDestinations",

      "identitystore:Describe*",
      "sso-directory:Describe*",
      "sso-directory:ListMembersInGroup",
      "cloudwatch:GetMetricStatistics",
    ]
    resources = ["*"]
  }

  statement {
    effect = "Allow"
    actions = [
      "ec2:CopySnapshot",
      "ec2:CreateSnapshot",
      "ec2:GetEbsEncryptionByDefault",
      "ec2:DescribeSnapshots",
    ]
    resources = ["*"]
  }

  statement {
    effect    = "Allow"
    actions   = ["ec2:CreateTags"]
    resources = ["arn:aws:ec2:*::snapshot/*"]
  }

  statement {
    effect  = "Allow"
    actions = ["kms:CreateAlias"]
    resources = [
      "arn:aws:kms:*:*:alias/wizKey",
      "arn:aws:kms:*:*:key/*",
    ]
  }

  statement {
    effect = "Allow"
    actions = [
      "kms:GetKeyPolicy",
      "kms:PutKeyPolicy",
    ]
    resources = ["*"]

    condition {
      test     = "StringEquals"
      variable = "aws:ResourceTag/wiz"
      values   = ["auto-gen-cmk"]
    }
  }

  statement {
    effect = "Allow"
    actions = [
      "ec2:DeleteSnapshot",
      "ec2:ModifySnapshotAttribute",
    ]
    resources = ["*"]

    condition {
      test     = "StringEquals"
      variable = "ec2:ResourceTag/wiz"
      values   = ["auto-gen-snapshot"]
    }
  }

  statement {
    sid       = "WizAccessS3"
    effect    = "Deny"
    actions   = ["s3:GetObject"]
    resources = ["*"]
  }
}

  name   = "WizCustomPolicy"
  role   = aws_iam_role.wiz_access.id
  policy = data.aws_iam_policy_document.wiz_custom.json
}

  description = "ARN of the cross-account IAM role"

}

output "role_name" {
  description = "Name of the cross-account IAM role"
  value       = aws_iam_role.wiz_access.name
}

final_template:
variable "tags" {
  description = "Map of tags to apply to all resources"
  type        = map(string)
  default     = {}
}

data "aws_iam_policy_document" "ec2_assume_role" {
  statement {
    sid     = "EC2AssumeRole"
    effect  = "Allow"
    actions = ["sts:AssumeRole"]

    principals {
      type        = "Service"
      identifiers = ["ec2.amazonaws.com"]
    }
  }
}

# Control plane

data "aws_iam_policy_document" "aws_ccm_k8s_controlplane" {
  statement {
    sid    = "CloudControllerManagerControlPlane"
    effect = "Allow"
    actions = [
      "autoscaling:DescribeAutoScalingGroups",
      "autoscaling:DescribeLaunchConfigurations",
      "autoscaling:DescribeTags",
      "ec2:DescribeInstances",
      "ec2:DescribeRegions",
      "ec2:DescribeRouteTables",
      "ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups",
      "ec2:DescribeSubnets",
      "ec2:DescribeVolumes",
      "ec2:DescribeAvailabilityZones",
      "ec2:DescribeVpcs",
      "ec2:CreateSecurityGroup",
      "ec2:CreateTags",
      "ec2:CreateVolume",
      "ec2:ModifyInstanceAttribute",
      "ec2:ModifyVolume",
      "ec2:AttachVolume",
      "ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress",
      "ec2:CreateRoute",
      "ec2:DeleteRoute",
      "ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup",
      "ec2:DeleteVolume",
      "ec2:DetachVolume",
      "ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress",
      "elasticloadbalancing:AddTags",
      "elasticloadbalancing:AttachLoadBalancerToSubnets",
      "elasticloadbalancing:ApplySecurityGroupsToLoadBalancer",
      "elasticloadbalancing:CreateLoadBalancer",
      "elasticloadbalancing:CreateLoadBalancerPolicy",
      "elasticloadbalancing:CreateLoadBalancerListeners",
      "elasticloadbalancing:ConfigureHealthCheck",
      "elasticloadbalancing:DeleteLoadBalancer",
      "elasticloadbalancing:DeleteLoadBalancerListeners",
      "elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancers",
      "elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancerAttributes",
      "elasticloadbalancing:DetachLoadBalancerFromSubnets",
      "elasticloadbalancing:DeregisterInstancesFromLoadBalancer",
      "elasticloadbalancing:ModifyLoadBalancerAttributes",
      "elasticloadbalancing:RegisterInstancesWithLoadBalancer",
      "elasticloadbalancing:SetLoadBalancerPoliciesForBackendServer",
      "elasticloadbalancing:CreateListener",
      "elasticloadbalancing:CreateTargetGroup",
      "elasticloadbalancing:DeleteListener",
      "elasticloadbalancing:DeleteTargetGroup",
      "elasticloadbalancing:DescribeListeners",
      "elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancerPolicies",
      "elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetGroups",
      "elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetHealth",
      "elasticloadbalancing:ModifyListener",
      "elasticloadbalancing:ModifyTargetGroup",
      "elasticloadbalancing:RegisterTargets",
      "elasticloadbalancing:DeregisterTargets",
      "elasticloadbalancing:SetLoadBalancerPoliciesOfListener",
      "iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole",
      "kms:DescribeKey",
    ]
    resources = ["*"]
  }
}

resource "aws_iam_role" "aws_ccm_k8s_controlplane" {
  name               = "aws_ccm_k8s_controlplane"
  assume_role_policy = data.aws_iam_policy_document.ec2_assume_role.json
  tags               = var.tags
}

resource "aws_iam_policy" "aws_ccm_k8s_controlplane" {
  name        = "aws_ccm_k8s_controlplane"
  description = "Permissions for the AWS Cloud Controller Manager on Kubernetes control plane nodes"
  policy      = data.aws_iam_policy_document.aws_ccm_k8s_controlplane.json
  tags        = var.tags
}

resource "aws_iam_role_policy_attachment" "aws_ccm_k8s_controlplane" {
  role       = aws_iam_role.aws_ccm_k8s_controlplane.name
  policy_arn = aws_iam_policy.aws_ccm_k8s_controlplane.arn
}

resource "aws_iam_instance_profile" "aws_ccm_k8s_controlplane" {
  name = "aws_ccm_k8s_controlplane"
  role = aws_iam_role.aws_ccm_k8s_controlplane.name
  tags = var.tags
}

# Worker

data "aws_iam_policy_document" "aws_ccm_k8s_worker" {
  statement {
    sid    = "CloudControllerManagerWorker"
    effect = "Allow"
    actions = [
      "ec2:DescribeInstances",
      "ec2:DescribeRegions",
    ]
    resources = ["*"]
  }

  statement {
    sid    = "ECRReadOnly"
    effect = "Allow"
    actions = [
      "ecr:GetAuthorizationToken",
      "ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability",
      "ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer",
      "ecr:GetRepositoryPolicy",
      "ecr:DescribeRepositories",
      "ecr:ListImages",
      "ecr:BatchGetImage",
    ]
    resources = ["*"]
  }
}

resource "aws_iam_role" "aws_ccm_k8s_worker" {
  name               = "aws_ccm_k8s_worker"
  assume_role_policy = data.aws_iam_policy_document.ec2_assume_role.json
  tags               = var.tags
}

resource "aws_iam_policy" "aws_ccm_k8s_worker" {
  name        = "aws_ccm_k8s_worker"
  description = "Permissions for the AWS Cloud Controller Manager and ECR image pulls on Kubernetes worker nodes"
  policy      = data.aws_iam_policy_document.aws_ccm_k8s_worker.json
  tags        = var.tags
}

resource "aws_iam_role_policy_attachment" "aws_ccm_k8s_worker" {
  role       = aws_iam_role.aws_ccm_k8s_worker.name
  policy_arn = aws_iam_policy.aws_ccm_k8s_worker.arn
}

resource "aws_iam_instance_profile" "aws_ccm_k8s_worker" {
  name = "aws_ccm_k8s_worker"
  role = aws_iam_role.aws_ccm_k8s_worker.name
  tags = var.tags
}

output "controlplane_role_arn" {
  value = aws_iam_role.aws_ccm_k8s_controlplane.arn
}

output "controlplane_instance_profile_name" {
  value = aws_iam_instance_profile.aws_ccm_k8s_controlplane.name
}

output "worker_role_arn" {
  value = aws_iam_role.aws_ccm_k8s_worker.arn
}

output "worker_instance_profile_name" {
  value = aws_iam_instance_profile.aws_ccm_k8s_worker.name
}

final_template:
terraform {
  required_version = ">= 1.3.0"

  required_providers {
    aws = {
      source  = "hashicorp/aws"
      version = ">= 4.0"
    }
  }
}

variable "environment" {
  description = "Environment name appended to IAM user names."
  type        = string
  default     = "dev"
}

variable "name_prefix" {
  description = "Prefix used for IAM user names."
  type        = string
  default     = "mattermost"
}

variable "create_db_dr_user" {
  description = "Whether to create the database disaster recovery IAM user."
  type        = bool
  default     = false
}

variable "create_data_exports_user" {
  description = "Whether to create the data exports IAM user."
  type        = bool
  default     = false
}

variable "create_packer_user" {
  description = "Whether to create the Packer image builder IAM user."
  type        = bool
  default     = false
}

variable "export_bucket_arn" {
  description = "ARN of the S3 bucket used for data exports (e.g. arn:aws:s3:::my-export-bucket)."
  type        = string
  default     = ""

  validation {
    condition     = var.export_bucket_arn == "" || can(regex("^arn:aws[a-zA-Z-]*:s3:::[a-z0-9.-]+$", var.export_bucket_arn))
    error_message = "export_bucket_arn must be empty or a valid S3 bucket ARN."
  }
}

variable "monitoring_state_bucket_name" {
  description = "Name of the S3 bucket holding monitoring state accessed by the Packer user."
  type        = string
  default     = "mattermost-monitoring-state"
}

variable "bind_server_lambda_function_name" {
  description = "Name of the Lambda function managing bind server network attachment."
  type        = string
  default     = "bind-server-network-attachment"
}

variable "bind_server_role_name" {
  description = "Name of the dedicated server IAM role the Packer user may pass. Defaults to bind-server-role-<region> when empty."
  type        = string
  default     = ""
}

variable "tags" {
  description = "Tags applied to all IAM users."
  type        = map(string)
  default     = {}
}

data "aws_region" "current" {}

data "aws_caller_identity" "current" {}

data "aws_partition" "current" {}

locals {
  account_id = data.aws_caller_identity.current.account_id
  region     = data.aws_region.current.name
  partition  = data.aws_partition.current.partition

  bind_server_role_name = var.bind_server_role_name != "" ? var.bind_server_role_name : "bind-server-role-${local.region}"

  create_data_exports_user = var.create_data_exports_user && var.export_bucket_arn != ""

  common_tags = merge(
    {
      Environment = var.environment
      ManagedBy   = "terraform"
    },
    var.tags
  )
}

########################################
# Cost reporting user (mandatory)
########################################

resource "aws_iam_user" "cost_report" {
  name = "${var.name_prefix}-cost-report-${var.environment}"
  path = "/"
  tags = local.common_tags
}

data "aws_iam_policy_document" "cost_report" {
  statement {
    sid       = "CostExplorerFullAccess"
    effect    = "Allow"
    actions   = ["ce:*"]
    resources = ["*"]
  }
}

resource "aws_iam_user_policy" "cost_report" {
  name   = "${var.name_prefix}-cost-report-${var.environment}"
  user   = aws_iam_user.cost_report.name
  policy = data.aws_iam_policy_document.cost_report.json
}

########################################
# Database disaster recovery user (optional)
########################################

resource "aws_iam_user" "db_dr" {
  count = var.create_db_dr_user ? 1 : 0

  name = "${var.name_prefix}-db-disaster-recovery-${var.environment}"
  path = "/"
  tags = local.common_tags
}

data "aws_iam_policy_document" "db_dr" {
  statement {
    sid       = "RDSFullAccess"
    effect    = "Allow"
    actions   = ["rds:*"]
    resources = ["*"]
  }

  statement {
    sid       = "KMSFullAccess"
    effect    = "Allow"
    actions   = ["kms:*"]
    resources = ["*"]
  }

  statement {
    sid    = "SecretsManagerMultitenantRDS"
    effect = "Allow"
    actions = [
      "secretsmanager:CreateSecret",
      "secretsmanager:DescribeSecret",
      "secretsmanager:GetSecretValue",
      "secretsmanager:PutSecretValue",
      "secretsmanager:UpdateSecret",
      "secretsmanager:DeleteSecret",
      "secretsmanager:RestoreSecret",
      "secretsmanager:TagResource",
      "secretsmanager:UntagResource",
      "secretsmanager:ListSecretVersionIds",
    ]
    resources = [
      "arn:${local.partition}:secretsmanager:${local.region}:${local.account_id}:secret:rds-cluster-multitenant-*",
    ]
  }

  statement {
    sid       = "SecretsManagerList"
    effect    = "Allow"
    actions   = ["secretsmanager:ListSecrets"]
    resources = ["*"]
  }
}

resource "aws_iam_user_policy" "db_dr" {
  count = var.create_db_dr_user ? 1 : 0

  name   = "${var.name_prefix}-db-disaster-recovery-${var.environment}"
  user   = aws_iam_user.db_dr[0].name
  policy = data.aws_iam_policy_document.db_dr.json
}

########################################
# Data exports user (optional)
########################################

resource "aws_iam_user" "data_exports" {
  count = local.create_data_exports_user ? 1 : 0

  name = "${var.name_prefix}-data-exports-${var.environment}"
  path = "/"
  tags = local.common_tags
}

data "aws_iam_policy_document" "data_exports" {
  count = local.create_data_exports_user ? 1 : 0

  statement {
    sid    = "ListExportBucket"
    effect = "Allow"
    actions = [
      "s3:ListBucket",
      "s3:GetBucketLocation",
    ]
    resources = [var.export_bucket_arn]
  }

  statement {
    sid    = "ReadWriteExportObjects"
    effect = "Allow"
    actions = [
      "s3:GetObject",
      "s3:PutObject",
      "s3:DeleteObject",
      "s3:AbortMultipartUpload",
      "s3:ListMultipartUploadParts",
    ]
    resources = ["${var.export_bucket_arn}/*"]
  }
}

resource "aws_iam_user_policy" "data_exports" {
  count = local.create_data_exports_user ? 1 : 0

  name   = "${var.name_prefix}-data-exports-${var.environment}"
  user   = aws_iam_user.data_exports[0].name
  policy = data.aws_iam_policy_document.data_exports[0].json
}

########################################
# Packer image builder user (optional)
########################################

resource "aws_iam_user" "packer" {
  count = var.create_packer_user ? 1 : 0

  name = "${var.name_prefix}-packer-${var.environment}"
  path = "/"
  tags = local.common_tags
}

data "aws_iam_policy_document" "packer" {
  statement {
    sid    = "EC2ImageBuilding"
    effect = "Allow"
    actions = [
      "ec2:AllocateAddress",
      "ec2:AssociateAddress",
      "ec2:AssociateIamInstanceProfile",
      "ec2:AttachNetworkInterface",
      "ec2:AttachVolume",
      "ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupEgress",
      "ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress",
      "ec2:CopyImage",
      "ec2:CreateImage",
      "ec2:CreateKeyPair",
      "ec2:CreateLaunchTemplate",
      "ec2:CreateLaunchTemplateVersion",
      "ec2:CreateNetworkInterface",
      "ec2:CreateSecurityGroup",
      "ec2:CreateSnapshot",
      "ec2:CreateTags",
      "ec2:CreateVolume",
      "ec2:DeleteKeyPair",
      "ec2:DeleteLaunchTemplate",
      "ec2:DeleteLaunchTemplateVersions",
      "ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface",
      "ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup",
      "ec2:DeleteSnapshot",
      "ec2:DeleteTags",
      "ec2:DeleteVolume",
      "ec2:DeregisterImage",
      "ec2:Describe*",
      "ec2:DetachNetworkInterface",
      "ec2:DetachVolume",
      "ec2:DisassociateAddress",
      "ec2:DisassociateIamInstanceProfile",
      "ec2:GetPasswordData",
      "ec2:ModifyImageAttribute",
      "ec2:ModifyInstanceAttribute",
      "ec2:ModifyLaunchTemplate",
      "ec2:ModifyNetworkInterfaceAttribute",
      "ec2:ModifySnapshotAttribute",
      "ec2:RegisterImage",
      "ec2:ReleaseAddress",
      "ec2:ReplaceIamInstanceProfileAssociation",
      "ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupEgress",
      "ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress",
      "ec2:RunInstances",
      "ec2:StartInstances",
      "ec2:StopInstances",
      "ec2:TerminateInstances",
    ]
    resources = ["*"]
  }

  statement {
    sid    = "AutoScaling"
    effect = "Allow"
    actions = [
      "autoscaling:AttachInstances",
      "autoscaling:CompleteLifecycleAction",
      "autoscaling:CreateAutoScalingGroup",
      "autoscaling:CreateOrUpdateTags",
      "autoscaling:DeleteAutoScalingGroup",
      "autoscaling:DeleteLifecycleHook",
      "autoscaling:DeleteTags",
      "autoscaling:Describe*",
      "autoscaling:DetachInstances",
      "autoscaling:PutLifecycleHook",
      "autoscaling:RecordLifecycleActionHeartbeat",
      "autoscaling:SetDesiredCapacity",
      "autoscaling:StartInstanceRefresh",
      "autoscaling:CancelInstanceRefresh",
      "autoscaling:SuspendProcesses",
      "autoscaling:ResumeProcesses",
      "autoscaling:TerminateInstanceInAutoScalingGroup",
      "autoscaling:UpdateAutoScalingGroup",
    ]
    resources = ["*"]
  }

  statement {
    sid    = "CloudWatchEvents"
    effect = "Allow"
    actions = [
      "events:DeleteRule",
      "events:DescribeRule",
      "events:DisableRule",
      "events:EnableRule",
      "events:ListRules",
      "events:ListTagsForResource",
      "events:ListTargetsByRule",
      "events:PutRule",
      "events:PutTargets",
      "events:RemoveTargets",
      "events:TagResource",
      "events:UntagResource",
    ]
    resources = ["*"]
  }

  statement {
    sid    = "SSMParameters"
    effect = "Allow"
    actions = [
      "ssm:DescribeParameters",
      "ssm:GetParameter",
      "ssm:GetParameters",
      "ssm:GetParametersByPath",
      "ssm:PutParameter",
      "ssm:DeleteParameter",
      "ssm:AddTagsToResource",
      "ssm:ListTagsForResource",
    ]
    resources = ["*"]
  }

  statement {
    sid    = "IAMInspection"
    effect = "Allow"
    actions = [
      "iam:GetInstanceProfile",
      "iam:GetRole",
      "iam:GetRolePolicy",
      "iam:ListAttachedRolePolicies",
      "iam:ListInstanceProfiles",
      "iam:ListInstanceProfilesForRole",
      "iam:ListRolePolicies",
      "iam:ListRoles",
    ]
    resources = ["*"]
  }

  statement {
    sid    = "MonitoringStateBucketList"
    effect = "Allow"
    actions = [
      "s3:ListBucket",
      "s3:GetBucketLocation",
    ]
    resources = ["arn:${local.partition}:s3:::${var.monitoring_state_bucket_name}"]
  }

  statement {
    sid    = "MonitoringStateBucketObjects"
    effect = "Allow"
    actions = [
      "s3:GetObject",
      "s3:PutObject",
      "s3:DeleteObject",
    ]
    resources = ["arn:${local.partition}:s3:::${var.monitoring_state_bucket_name}/*"]
  }

  statement {
    sid    = "BindServerLambdaConfiguration"
    effect = "Allow"
    actions = [
      "lambda:AddPermission",
      "lambda:GetFunction",
      "lambda:GetFunctionConfiguration",
      "lambda:GetPolicy",
      "lambda:InvokeFunction",
      "lambda:RemovePermission",
      "lambda:UpdateFunctionConfiguration",
    ]
    resources = [
      "arn:${local.partition}:lambda:${local.region}:${local.account_id}:function:${var.bind_server_lambda_function_name}",
    ]
  }

  statement {
    sid       = "PassBindServerRole"
    effect    = "Allow"
    actions   = ["iam:PassRole"]
    resources = ["arn:${local.partition}:iam::${local.account_id}:role/${local.bind_server_role_name}"]
  }
}

resource "aws_iam_user_policy" "packer" {
  count = var.create_packer_user ? 1 : 0

  name   = "${var.name_prefix}-packer-${var.environment}"
  user   = aws_iam_user.packer[0].name
  policy = data.aws_iam_policy_document.packer.json
}

########################################
# Outputs
########################################

output "cost_report_user_name" {
  description = "Name of the cost reporting IAM user."
  value       = aws_iam_user.cost_report.name
}

output "cost_report_user_arn" {
  description = "ARN of the cost reporting IAM user."
  value       = aws_iam_user.cost_report.arn
}

output "db_dr_user_arn" {
  description = "ARN of the database disaster recovery IAM user, if created."
  value       = try(aws_iam_user.db_dr[0].arn, null)
}

output "data_exports_user_arn" {
  description = "ARN of the data exports IAM user, if created."
  value       = try(aws_iam_user.data_exports[0].arn, null)
}

output "packer_user_arn" {
  description = "ARN of the Packer image builder IAM user, if created."

variable "cloudhealth_account_id" {
  description = "AWS account ID of the CloudHealth SaaS platform that will assume the role"
  type        = string
  default     = "454464851268"
}

variable "external_id" {
  description = "External ID provided by CloudHealth for the cross-account trust relationship"
  type        = string
  sensitive   = true

  validation {
    condition     = length(var.external_id) > 0
    error_message = "external_id must be a non-empty string."
  }
}

variable "role_name" {
  description = "Name of the IAM role and policy"
  type        = string
  default     = "CloudHealth-IAM-Role"
}

variable "tags" {
  description = "Tags to apply to IAM resources"
  type        = map(string)
  default = {
    ManagedBy = "Terraform"
    Purpose   = "CloudHealth"
  }
}

data "aws_iam_policy_document" "cloudhealth_assume_role" {
  statement {
    sid     = "CloudHealthCrossAccountAssumeRole"
    effect  = "Allow"
    actions = ["sts:AssumeRole"]

    principals {
      type        = "AWS"
      identifiers = ["arn:aws:iam::${var.cloudhealth_account_id}:root"]
    }

    condition {
      test     = "StringEquals"
      variable = "sts:ExternalId"
      values   = [var.external_id]
    }
  }
}
